SELECT
    "id",
    "name",
    "event_space",
    "capacity",
    "address",
    "contactinfo"
FROM
    "eventspaces"
WHERE
    "capacity" >= 200
    AND (
        LOWER("event_space") LIKE '%банкет%'
        OR LOWER("event_space") LIKE '%конференц%'
    )
ORDER BY
    "capacity" DESC;

4:
SELECT
    r."id",
    r."name" AS restaurant_name,
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine",
    'Все рестораны' AS category
FROM
    "restaurants" r
UNION
SELECT
    r."id",
    r."name" AS restaurant_name,
    r."address",
    r."food_service",
    r."cuisine",
    'Кафе с итальянской кухней' AS category
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    LOWER(r."food_service") LIKE '%кафе%'
    AND LOWER(r."cuisine") LIKE '%итальян%'
ORDER BY
    category,
    restaurant_name;
5:
SELECT DISTINCT r."id", r."name", r."address", r."food_service", r."cuisine"
FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE LOWER(r."cuisine") LIKE '%итальян%'
  AND LOWER(r."food_service") IN ('ресторан', 'кафе');

SELECT
    s."id",
    s."name",
    'Chef' AS "staff_type"
FROM
    "staff" s
WHERE
    LOWER(TRIM(s."role")) LIKE '%chef%'

UNION ALL

SELECT
    s."id",
    s."name",
    'Server (English speaking)' AS "staff_type"
FROM
    "staff" s
WHERE
    LOWER(TRIM(s."role")) LIKE '%server%'
    AND LOWER(TRIM(s."language")) = 'english'
ORDER BY
    "staff_type",
    "name";

SELECT
    s."id",

    s."role",
    s."language"
FROM
    "staff" s
WHERE
    (LOWER(s."role") LIKE '%chef%' OR LOWER(s."role") LIKE '%server%')
    AND LOWER(s."language") LIKE '%english%';

SELECT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    s."system_id",
    s."system_name"
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
ORDER BY
    its."id", s."system_id";

WITH total_internships AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "id") AS total_count
    FROM "internships"
),
responsibility_counts AS (
    SELECT
        r."responsibility",
        COUNT(DISTINCT ir."internshipid") AS internship_count
    FROM "responsibilities" r
    JOIN "internships_responsibilities" ir ON r."id" = ir."responsibilityid"
    GROUP BY r."responsibility"
)
SELECT r."responsibility"
FROM responsibility_counts r
CROSS JOIN total_internships t
WHERE r."internship_count" = t."total_count";

FROM

SELECT
    j."minimum_years" AS minimum_experience_years,
    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years
FROM
    "jobs" j
WHERE
    j."salary" = (SELECT MAX("salary") FROM "jobs");
263:
SELECT
    "salarydetails"."hourly_rate" AS "expected_hourly_rate"
FROM
    "salarydetails"
JOIN
    "position" ON "salarydetails"."positionid" = "position"."id"
WHERE
    LOWER("position"."title") LIKE LOWER('%software%')
    AND LOWER("position"."title") LIKE LOWER('%developer%');
264:
SELECT
    p."title" AS job_position,
    sd."salary_range" AS salary_range
FROM
    "position" p
LEFT JOIN
    "salarydetails" sd ON p."id" = sd."positionid"
ORDER BY
    p."title";
266:
SELECT
    j."minimum_years" AS minimum_required_experience,
    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience,
    j."jobtitle" AS position_title
FROM
    "jobs" j
WHERE
    j."salary" = (SELECT MAX("salary") FROM "jobs")
LIMIT 1;
